intent: Add OntologyFoundation ontology grounding OntologyGroundingResolver and HarnessBundle semantic requirements in v4.6 while deepening professional Source-to-Harness reasoning and preserving every v4.5 capability.
objective: Deliver an additive v4.6.0 foundation that grounds evidence-bound professional concepts in a minimal Engine-owned OntologyFoundation, deepens Source-to-Harness reasoning and immutable Bundle quality, and makes semantic compatibility explicit without allowing labels, retrieval, LLMs, Hosts, or semantic results to acquire Harness Eligibility, approval, publication, or runtime authority.

explicit approval of the exact three-repository Roadmap set only
user-reviewed and explicitly approved Roadmap revision proposal; authorizes Target drafting but not implementation or release
explicit request to draft and review Target revision 1; not Target approval, implementation authorization, acceptance, or release
published v4.5.0 capability and acceptance baseline imported through explicit lineage
accepted module and product boundary; implementation must update it only within the approved Roadmap boundary
local non-product design constraint for minimal Foundation and non-executable user knowledge

include: Extend existing module 8 without adding a new authority plane: define OntologyFoundation/v1, SemanticCandidateSet/v1, OntologyGroundingResolver/v1, and immutable OntologyGroundingResult/v1 contracts with deterministic validation, canonicalization, provenance, evidence, uncertainty, and resource bounds

Implement exactly six grounding outcomes with deterministic precedence, finite user actions, append-only re-analysis, drift rejection, and explicit separation of deterministic signals, LLM advice, and Engine decision authority

Deepen professional Source-to-Harness extraction and finite Harness decision explanations for business objects, capabilities, tasks, roles, constraints, workflows, failure/recovery, validators, positive cases, negative cases, alternatives, risks, expected effects, and missing evidence
Add optional versioned HarnessSemanticRequirements/v1 to HarnessBundle authoring, matching, review, immutable closure, Catalog metadata, export, CLI, MCP, Digital Expert, and Harness Hub projections
Add SemanticCompatibilityReport/v1 and keep it independent from Harness Eligibility, Proposal Review, approval, publication, and Catalog activation

Update ADR 0001, architecture documentation, schemas, validators, module dependency guards, public documentation, migration-free fresh-start examples, and generated Digital Expert semantics for the approved v4.6 boundary
Retain the complete v4.5.0 classification and Harness producer capability baseline through explicit 203-item acceptance inheritance and full no-regression replay

Use exactly RC01-RC05 top-level designated-human WorkBuddy journeys with complete independent machine variants and no Candidate creation for runner, fixture, manifest, transport, or evidence-only failures
exclude: ProjectOntologyArtifactSet or ProjectOntologySkill authoring, publication, installation, activation, or consumption

compatibilityPolicy.rule: Every published v4.5.0 product capability, safety invariant, authority boundary, and acceptance criterion remains applicable and must pass on v4.6.0; no artifact or protocol reset is declared.

acceptance.criterion: Define and validate OntologyFoundation/v1 as the minimal Engine-owned non-executable meta-model for Entity, Attribute, Relationship, Rule, Event, Action, Actor, Role, Permission, State, Workflow, Capability, System, and DataAsset, with stable identifiers, canonical form, declared relation semantics, bounded resources, and no built-in vertical business truth.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schemas, positive and negative fixtures, canonicalization tests, resource-bound tests, and architecture guard evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Extract SemanticCandidateSet/v1 from the immutable static Source snapshot and Evidence Graph with evidence citations, provenance, contradictions, uncertainty, deterministic non-LLM signals, and advisory LLM contributions recorded separately.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Deterministic extraction fixtures across CRM, ERP, middleware, diagnosis, reconciliation, recovery, and non-Harness Sources; replay and provenance tests.

acceptance.criterion: Implement OntologyGroundingResolver/v1 with exactly RESOLVED, UNRESOLVED_CONCEPT, AMBIGUOUS_CONCEPT, CONFLICTING_CONCEPT, EXTENSION_REQUIRED, and EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT terminal outcomes, deterministic precedence, cited evidence, finite user actions, and immutable analysis bindings.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schema, decision-table, precedence, adversarial, replay, drift, and user-action tests for every outcome.

acceptance.criterion: Require every authoritative ontology identifier in a grounding result or semantic requirement to resolve from a validated Engine Foundation or exact user-owned immutable semantic context; an LLM may supply advisory evidence but cannot invent, directly select, activate, approve, or publish an authoritative identifier.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Hostile-Advisor fixtures, unknown-id rejection, provenance inspection, authority tests, and deterministic aggregate evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Add HarnessSemanticRequirements/v1 to HarnessBundle authoring, matching, review, immutable dependency closure, and export, and produce a SemanticCompatibilityReport/v1 that remains logically and operationally separate from Harness Eligibility.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Schema and migration-free fresh-start fixtures, matching and review tests, dependency/digest closure tests, and independent Eligibility-versus-compatibility matrix.

acceptance.criterion: Fail closed on every attempt in v4.6.0 to publish, install, activate, or represent ProjectOntologyArtifactSet or ProjectOntologySkill as a supported product asset.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Negative schema, Catalog, Registry, publication, Hub, CLI, MCP, and package-surface tests proving the v4.7 asset kinds are absent.

acceptance.criterion: Deepen Source-to-Harness reasoning to extract evidence-bound business objects, capabilities, task classes, roles, constraints, workflows, failure modes, recovery rules, validators, and positive and negative cases without treating labels or similarity as authority.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Professional Source corpus, evidence-link completeness checks, negative fixtures, and deterministic reasoning reports.

acceptance.criterion: For every finite Harness decision, explain professional sufficiency, reusable boundary, alternatives, rejection reasons, risks, expected effects, missing evidence, and known limits without permitting insufficient evidence to create a broad generic Profile or Bundle.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Decision-table tests, explanation completeness validators, insufficient-evidence negatives, and business-facing interaction evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Produce HarnessProfiles and immutable HarnessBundles with complete professional boundary specificity, dependency closure, validator coverage, Evaluation coverage, semanticRequirements closure, rollback information, and consumer-safe digests.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Bundle graph validation, Evaluation positive and negative cases, Catalog publication in an isolated test root, export inspection, and EvoPilot consumer-contract conformance fixture.

acceptance.criterion: Compare v4.6 professional reasoning and Bundle quality with a frozen v4.5.0 baseline only under context-equivalent bindings, preserving uncertainty, conflicts, raw observations, append-only rescoring, and non-activating calibration.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Paired comparison manifests, context-comparability tests, uncertainty and conflict reports, append-only rescore evidence, and calibration non-activation guards.

acceptance.criterion: Preserve every v4.5.0 classification, explicit continue handoff, Harness Eligibility, Harness evolution, Proposal Review, approval, separate publication, Catalog validation, Host conformance, restart, recovery, and safe-close behavior under ordinary INHERIT compatibility.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Complete 203-item inherited acceptance replay, five-journey E2E portfolio, independent Host evidence, WorkBuddy final declaration, and NO_REGRESSION report.

acceptance.criterion: Keep Source ingestion static and read-only, provider configuration external and user-owned, LLM advice non-authoritative, and Agent Hosts outside Engine reasoning, approval, publication, credential, and runtime-state ownership.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Security, Source non-execution, credential redaction, provider-neutrality, Host-authority, and architecture dependency tests.

acceptance.criterion: Professional CRM, ERP, middleware, diagnosis, reconciliation, recovery, and non-Harness Sources produce evidence-backed distinct grounding and Harness decisions rather than label-similarity collapse.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-domain real-case matrix with independently reviewed expected decision classes, citations, alternatives, and false-broad-match assertions.

acceptance.criterion: Insufficient, contradictory, ambiguous, unknown, or extension-required professional evidence abstains safely and cannot produce a broad generic Profile or Bundle.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Negative real cases for all five non-resolved grounding outcomes plus broad-profile and broad-bundle prohibition assertions.

acceptance.criterion: A reviewed and separately published HarnessBundle carries complete immutable professional, semantic, dependency, validator, Evaluation, provenance, and rollback closure that a read-only EvoPilot consumer can validate.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Fresh isolated publication, Catalog readback, immutable export, dependency closure, and consumer validation evidence.

acceptance.criterion: The user can see semantic compatibility and Harness Eligibility as two independent conclusions: neither status silently changes, proves, approves, or suppresses the other.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Cross-product decision matrix and real-host interaction evidence for every compatibility-by-Eligibility combination.

acceptance.criterion: The v4.5 user-authored business classification scheme and Host-authority boundaries continue unchanged while OntologyFoundation adds only generic semantic primitives.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Two-user Taxonomy regression, no built-in vertical vocabulary inspection, cross-Host conformance, and authority-boundary tests.

acceptance.criterion: An ordinary user can complete the full retained classification-to-Harness lifecycle through explicit continue, Eligibility, professional reasoning, Catalog comparison, finite evolution decision, Proposal Review, approval, separately authorized publication, validation, and safe close.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: One complete fresh Workspace lifecycle in designated-human WorkBuddy and equivalent Engine-owned semantics through an independent conformant Host.

acceptance.criterion: After an unresolved, ambiguous, conflicting, extension-required, or evidence-insufficient grounding result, only an explicit user-supplied semantic-context repair and new analysis may advance; the prior result remains immutable.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Repair and re-analysis journeys with digest drift, stale-action rejection, append-only history, and no automatic semantic mutation.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly five top-level real-host journeys cover the v4.6 user experience while independent machine variants retain every Source, grounding, professional-reasoning, security, failure, Host, and inherited assertion.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Frozen RC01-RC05 runbooks, machine-variant matrix, coverage validator, independent Host results, and designated-human range declaration.

acceptance.criterion: Ordinary users receive project business meaning, compatibility, execution capability, gaps, evidence, alternatives, and next actions in understandable language while audit identifiers and digests remain available separately.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: BusinessDecisionView and ComplianceAuditEnvelope interaction tests across Hosts and accessibility review of required fields.

acceptance.criterion: v4.6.0 remains a grounding and professional-reasoning foundation only: no ProjectOntologyArtifactSet, ProjectOntologySkill, multi-Pack lifecycle, external semantic interoperability, incremental graph reasoning, automatic approval, or automatic publication becomes available.
acceptance.requiredEvidence: Public API, schema, CLI, MCP, Catalog, Registry, package-content, documentation, and forbidden-capability tests.
